t: You're at Haberdashers' Hatcham College, a state secondary school with a music specialism in New Cross, south-east London. It has been a grammar school and a City Technology College, and it is now an academy working across two sites near New Cross Gate. The school traces back to Robert Aske, a seventeenth-century merchant and haberdasher who served as an Alderman of London, and who is described as a philanthropist. He founded it, which is why the Haberdashers' name is still attached.
